facts.description: Source code for Processing, the software sketchbook and Java-based programming language for students, artists, designers, educators, hobbyists, and creative coders. Includes the core library, and editor (PDE)

license.head:
Introduction ==================================================================================================== We use GPL v2 for the parts of the project that we've developed ourselves. For the 'core' library, it's LGPL, for everything else, it's GPL. Over the course of many years of development, files being moved around, and other code being added and removed, the license information has become quite a mess. Please help us clean this up so that others are properly credited and licenses are consistently/correctly noted: https://github.com/processing/processing/issues/224

GNU GPL License

research.name: Processing
research.note: Software sketchbook and Java-based language where a short sketch with setup() and draw() opens a graphics window when you press Run.
research.license: GPL-2.0 for the editor and other parts, LGPL for the core library, with some bundled third-party code under other licenses (LICENSE.md)

effects: sketchbook editor with a single Run button that opens the sketch in a separate display window
setup()/draw() sketch structure for drawing 2D and 3D graphics in a few lines of code
